name: Pro Integration

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pro'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'pro'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  integration:
    if: ${{ env.AIOT_PAT != '' }}
    env:
      AIOT_PAT: ${{ secrets.AIOT_PAT }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository with submodules
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
          token: ${{ env.AIOT_PAT }}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: npm test
